seven_q.Q0_posture: This document takes a stance of radical ontological revision: it asserts that the current paradigm in physics is fundamentally broken and proposes a new foundational framework based on information primacy.
seven_q.Q1_identity: A formal scientific thesis proposing the Logos Field (χ) as the fundamental substrate of reality, unifying GR and QM, and deriving a Trinitarian structure as a necessary isomorphism.
seven_q.Q2_domain: Primarily physics and information theory, with deep intersections with philosophy of mind, theology, and mathematics.
seven_q.Q3_claim: Information is ontologically primitive; the χ-field resolves three foundational crises in physics; GR and QM are limit cases of a single coherence scale; the closing operator structure is necessarily triadic and maps to the Trinity.
seven_q.Q4_support: Formal axiomatic derivation, mathematical modeling (Master Equation, Lagrangian, ODCR), constraint elimination analysis, empirical predictions (ODCR), and falsification protocols.
seven_q.Q5_dependencies: Depends on the failure of materialism to resolve the measurement problem, the hard problem of consciousness, and the compression crisis; also depends on the validity of information-theoretic approaches to physics.
seven_q.Q6_consequences: Forces a re-evaluation of the nature of reality, consciousness, and ethics; implies a Trinitarian ontology; provides a unified framework for physics, theology, and AI alignment.
seven_q.Q7_kill: Kill conditions: (1) demonstration that conscious observation has zero effect on collapse rates, (2) a successful TOE without informational substrate, (3) demonstration of sustainable moral entropy reversal through unitary operations alone.
